name: Plant submerged vegetation
description: Plant pondweed and stonewort plugs on this tile.

name: Carp removal
description: Seine netting and electrofishing to remove most of the carp.

name: Carp barrier at inflow
description: A screen across the inflow channel that blocks adult carp.

name: Alum treatment
description: Aluminium sulfate binds phosphorus in the water and caps the sediment.

name: Barley straw bales
description: Float bales of barley straw in the pond. Widely recommended for clearing green water.
design_note: Red herring. Evidence for barley straw is weak, and algae are not what keeps this pond dark: suspended sediment from carp is.

name: Algaecide treatment
description: Dose the pond with an algaecide. The water greens less within days.
design_note: Red herring. Algae rebound within weeks because phosphorus is still high, and the sediment carp stir up still blocks the light.

name: Upstream nitrate agreement
description: Pay farms upstream to cut fertiliser runoff. Halves nitrate in the inflow from now on.
design_note: Red herring. Nitrate is not limiting anything here (phosphorus limits the algae, light and carp limit the plants). Good for the river, no help to this pond.

name: Raise the outlet weir
description: Raise the outlet weir by 30 cm to give the pond more water.
design_note: Red herring that backfires. Deeper water means less light at the bed, so plants find it harder to establish.
